reason: Owner-authorised 24 November 2026 scope extension for meeting-specific leadership appointments and temporary Transition Committee governance. The scope includes server-side Worker authorization, meeting UI and client authorization helpers, meeting category policy, and the corresponding Firestore meeting rules and regression tests. The change requires a complete Transition Committee for leadership-election infrastructure, permits repeated identities, requires all permanent appointments and closed election ballots before proceedings, and ends temporary authority atomically at proceedings start. No unrelated portal, collection or signature behavior is changed.

activityLog.description: Owner approval: "APPROVE 845 REAL meetings must never be deleted by anyone; only a meeting explicitly created as TRIAL may be deleted, by an administrator, with safeguards. This is my decision of 21 November 2026." PR #845; conditional on all required final-head checks green and policy guard failure repaired without bypass or hand-recorded PASS.

activityLog.action: owner instruction — attendance callable guard window opened
activityLog.description: Add regression guard that active Meeting Portal attendance and entry-request screens use Worker routes and never invoke undeployed Firebase callables. No signer, guest or duplicate-signer behavior is modified.

activityLog.action: owner-authorised scope extension — organisation-wide meeting initiation
activityLog.description: Owner authorised every active registered member and employee to initiate meetings; active members and staff participate in Staff and General meeting categories. Board voting, quorum and formal approval powers remain restricted. PR #941.

activityLog.action: Worker route policy and tests added
activityLog.description: Removed the category-role restriction from meeting initiation while retaining active-register validation; added Worker functional tests for active staff, active members and inactive identities. PR #941.

Code-path inspection confirmed the active Meeting Portal creates meetings through the authenticated Cloudflare Worker with server-side Firestore access. Direct Firestore rules changes are unnecessary and were reverted; the narrower browser-write boundary is preserved. PR #941.

activityLog.action: Fit implementation to existing Meeting Portal source-isolation allowlist
activityLog.description: Restored the shared meeting policy and removed the new Worker test file after the isolated fixture guard rejected them. Moved initiation controls to the already-authorised Meeting Centre page and placed functional Worker tests in the existing Meeting Portal policy test file. No guard was weakened. PR #941.

The Meeting Portal's shared dependencies are touched only to expose Signature Portal completed-document tracking. Meeting screens, meeting routes, meeting data and meeting permissions remain unchanged.

activityLog.action: owner-authorised meeting leadership and Transition Committee governance scope extension
activityLog.description: User explicitly authorised repair of all failed PR #955 tests, necessary rule changes, retesting, merge and live production promotion. Scope extended to the exact changed Meeting Portal source, Firestore meeting rules and regression test files; no multi-portal scope is included.

Closed legacy callable bypasses: only the meeting-specific Meeting Administrator can moderate LiveKit or start/stop recording; appointed leaders are admitted by meeting-scoped UID; uninvited global administrators cannot enter live rooms. The Cloudflare Worker remains the active client gateway.

activityLog.action: owner-authorised voting portal and ballot eligibility hardening
activityLog.description: Voting controls are now meeting-scoped; Transition Committee Chair/Secretary can open and close only leadership-election ballots; ordinary governance ballots are restricted to listed Board members; listed active members/employees can vote in pre-proceedings leadership elections.

activityLog.action: meeting participant data integration included in active scope
activityLog.description: The final scope also includes the meeting participant/voting data adapter used by the meeting and voting portals.

The Meeting Portal baseline and rollback target now match the exact PR #955 base commit 331201cb3c626cc96cd006fe8263bf69bafea9b1. Baseline smoke and full regression were verified successful on that exact commit using run 45385986460.
